Slider

Slider allows users to select a value or range from a continuous scale. Supports single and dual handles, marks, labels, and vertical orientation.

Basic Range Slider

A simple horizontal slider with a configurable min and max.

HTML
<label class="zak-label" for="sliderBasic">Volume</label>
<input type="range" class="zak-range" id="sliderBasic" min="0" max="100" value="50">

Slider with Value Display

Show the current value alongside the slider, updating live as the handle moves.

50%
HTML
<div class="zak-slider">
  <label class="zak-label" for="sliderValue">Opacity</label>
  <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-primary">50%</span>
  <input type="range" class="zak-range" id="sliderValue" min="0" max="100" value="50">
</div>
JS
<!-- Update the badge as the value changes -->
const slider = document.getElementById('sliderValue');
const badge  = document.getElementById('sliderValueText');
slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
  badge.textContent = slider.value + '%';
});

Slider with Marks / Steps

Snap the handle to predefined steps and optionally show tick marks.

12345678910
HTML
<label class="zak-label" for="sliderSteps">Rating</label>
<input type="range" class="zak-range" id="sliderSteps" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="5">
<div class="zak-slider-marks">
  <span>1</span><span>2</span>...
  <span>10</span>
</div>

Vertical Slider

A vertically oriented slider using the orient attribute.

HTML
<label class="zak-label" for="sliderVertical">Volume</label>
<input type="range" class="zak-range" id="sliderVertical"
       min="0" max="100" value="60"
       orient="vertical" style="writing-mode: vertical-ltr;">

Slider with Labels

Add min and max labels at the ends of the slider.

ColdWarmHot
HTML
<label class="zak-label" for="sliderLabels">Temperature</label>
<input type="range" class="zak-range" id="sliderLabels" min="-10" max="40" value="15">
<div class="zak-slider-labels">
  <span>Cold</span><span>Warm</span><span>Hot</span>
</div>

Dual-Range Slider

Two handles to select a range between a lower and upper bound.

Budget (min) Max
$0 $2,000
HTML
<div class="zak-range-dual">
  <div class="zak-range-dual-track"></div>
  <div class="zak-range-dual-fill"></div>
  <div class="zak-range-dual-handle zak-range-dual-handle-min"></div>
  <div class="zak-range-dual-handle zak-range-dual-handle-max"></div>
</div>
JS
const track = document.getElementById('dualTrack');
const min   = document.getElementById('dualMin');
const max   = document.getElementById('dualMax');
const minT  = document.getElementById('dualMinText');
const maxT  = document.getElementById('dualMaxText');
const container = track.parentElement;
let dragging = null;

function update() {
  const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const minPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(50, ((min.offsetLeft) / r.width) * 100));
  const maxPct = Math.max(50, Math.min(100, ((max.offsetLeft + 20) / r.width) * 100));
  track.style.left = minPct + '%';
  track.style.right = (100 - maxPct) + '%';
  minT.textContent = '$' + Math.round(minPct * 20);
  maxT.textContent = '$' + Math.round(maxPct * 20);
}

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-rangeBase range input styling
.zak-sliderSlider wrapper with label
.zak-slider-marksStep tick marks row
.zak-slider-labelsMin/max label row
.zak-range-dualDual-range container
.zak-range-dual-trackBase track
.zak-range-dual-fillHighlighted segment
.zak-range-dual-handleDraggable handle

Accessibility

  • Range inputs are natively focusable and keyboard-operable via arrow keys.
  • Provide a <label> linked via for / id for each slider.
  • Use aria-valuetext to provide human-readable values (e.g., "$500").
  • For dual-range sliders, mark each handle with role="slider", aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and distinct labels.
  • Ensure vertical sliders remain horizontally scrollable-friendly on touch devices.
